# glpi_software_category (Resource)

GLPI software category.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_software_category" "productivity" {
  name = "Productivity"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent. 0 means top level.

### Read-Only

- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_software_category.example 42
```
